pages.t: jq for YAML -- query and edit without reformatting
pages.l: Query and edit YAML from the command line. Chart a path to any field in a manifest — and edit it without reformatting the file.

pages.t: yqr Demo
pages.l: A runnable showcase of yqr, a jq-style query & transform tool for YAML.

pages.t: yqr guide
pages.l: Short, task-shaped pages. Every command in them was run against a real build, and the output you see is the output it printed.

pages.t: Byte-for-byte YAML editing, explained
pages.l: Most YAML tools work by parsing your file into data, doing something to the data, and printing the data back out. That last step is where formatting goes to die: the printer has opinions about...

pages.t: Editing Kubernetes manifests without reformatting them
pages.l: Manifests are checked in, reviewed, and argued over. So the useful property in a tool that edits them is not how much it can do -- it is how little it changes.

pages.t: Validating YAML from the command line
pages.l: An edit went in -- by hand, by a script, or by an agent. Is the file still correct?
